class.comment: Generate field-addressed authority validation for required values, bounds, exact ordinal absolute fragment-free Redirect URI and Post-Logout Redirect URI matching, Public-client no-secret plus S256 PKCE rules, Confidential-client Basic-or-client_secret_post authentication with dual-method rejection, active-client checks at authorization/device/token boundaries, allowed grant and case-sensitive Scope checks, uniqueness, known references, lifecycle state, Tenant ancestry, cycles, empty Resource Kind, cross-Tenant chains, stable identifiers, UTC timestamps, feature dependencies, optimistic concurrency, atomicity guarantees, and secret exclusion. Invalid requests must fail before partial persistence or credential issuance. Management validation additionally enforces pageNumber at least 1, pageSize from 1 through 100, idempotency keys from 1 through 200 characters, identical-request replay versus different-request conflict, required concurrency tokens for updates and state transitions, stale-token conflict without overwrite, action-specific management Scope authorization, and secret-safe response projection.
class.name: SecurityAuthorityValidation
